docling.claim_boundary: Streaming PDF runs the conversion pipeline and emits completed page chunks through a bounded channel; this does not establish that input decoding/OCR itself streams. --layers and --traverse-pictures are output serializer choices. Synthetic test disabled OCR, so no OCR speed/accuracy/memory claim. The release announcement's layer/traverse integration is new; the streaming mode itself predates v2.15, so same-release stream/no-stream measurements do not estimate a version delta.

prior_release_streaming.evidence: CLI lines 123-126 say Markdown streaming is default; stream.rs begins with streaming module and bounded CHANNEL_DEPTH=8 at line 28. This proves stream mode predates v2.15; v2.15 release delta is layer/picture serializer integration.
